Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 13:03:00 -0700
Subject: Acme MAP: Mutual Action Plan & next steps

Hi Laura / Sam

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap from my side + the proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have agreement on owners and dates. Please reply with any edits.

Key pain points we heard:
- Current inference latency variability (tail latency spikes) causing poor user experience on search and recommendation flows.
- High per-token cost at peak due to lack of batching + no prefix/KV cache across requests.
- Complex rollout risk: multiple teams, differing SLAs across EU and US regions.

Goals (Q2 priorities):
1) Stabilize tail latency under 200ms p95 for user-facing generation by July 15.
2) Reduce per-token inference cost by ~30% through batching + quantization recommendations by Aug 1.
3) Enable a safe pilot in US region (non-prod) with replayed traffic and observability hooks by May 20.

Stakeholders we captured:
- Product: Laura Gomez (Decision maker, prioritization)
- Engineering: Sam Patel (technical lead, integration owner)
- Security/Legal: "Acme Legal" (contract/KPI review)

Proposed MAP (milestones, owner, target date):
- 1) Pilot environment provisioning (non-prod cluster + VPC peering) — Owner: Redwood (Marissa/Rishi) — Target: 2027-05-07
- 2) Integration + test harness (traffic replay + tracing) — Owner: Acme Eng (Sam) — Target: 2027-05-20
- 3) Pilot run & performance validation (latency/cost baselines) — Owner: Joint (Acme + Redwood) — Target: 2027-06-10
- 4) Cost optimization & recommendations (batching/quantization configs) — Owner: Redwood (Rishi) — Target: 2027-07-01
- 5) Exec review & production rollout decision — Owner: Laura (Acme) — Target: 2027-07-15

Open questions / risks:
- Legal: NDA/SLA terms — Acme legal requested example SLA and data retention language.
- Capacity: If pilot shows higher-than-expected throughput, we may need dedicated capacity vs. shared hosted during rollout.
- Region parity: EU compliance checks could add a 4–6 week delay.

Attachments: I attached a first-pass MAP document (redwood-map-v1.pdf) and a pricing/SLA worksheet (redwood-sla-pricing.xlsx). I'll also attach an NDA template if you need.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Confirm owners & dates above (reply to this thread) — by 2027-04-05
2) Tech kick-off (30–45 min) with Sam + Redwood infra — schedule week of 2027-04-12
3) Redwood to share pilot runbook and access checklist — by 2027-04-08

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
